goal: Study exact unit-square packings for n=4 and n=5. Use two initial research routes with distinct goals, then use a third direct child for independent evidence review if useful. Children may delegate at most one further level. Wait for exploratory routes with all_settled, inspect failures, and return a final report with actual checker effect IDs. Every feasibility claim needs the exact checker. Distinguish an upper bound, an area-bound closure, and unresolved optimality. Do not create synthetic evidence IDs or infer proof from agent agreement.
